item.title: Hsenwi Transformed Under MNDAA Rule: From Saopha Heartland to a De Facto China Annex
item.description: “Entering Hsenwi now doesn’t feel the same as before; it feels like arriving in a small Chinese border town,” says Sai Leng (pseudonym), a traveler, speaking with a deep sense of loss.
